description: This file defines a Kotlin interface 'RecipeRepository' that specifies various methods for accessing recipe data, including fetching all recipes, filtering by cuisine, retrieving favorites, getting a recipe by ID, toggling favorite status, and listing available cuisines.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: An interface that abstracts the data access layer for recipe data, supporting multiple data sources such as local database or remote API.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of all recipes, enabling reactive updates.

methods.name: getRecipesByCuisine
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of recipes filtered by the specified cuisine.

methods.name: getFavoriteRecipes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of recipes marked as favorites.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve a single recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Suspending function to toggle the favorite status of a recipe identified by ID.

methods.name: getAvailableCuisines
methods.description: Returns a list of available cuisine types.
